news.title: Man dead after shooting near Greyhound Bus Station in southwest Atlanta
news.summary: A man was found dead from a gunshot wound near the Greyhound Bus Station in southwest Atlanta, with police investigating the circumstances of the shooting.

news.title: Gas station burglarized overnight in southeast Atlanta
news.summary: Atlanta police are investigating an overnight burglary at a southeast Atlanta gas station.

news.title: Atlanta Falcons finalize 53-man roster. Who made it and who was cut?
news.summary: The Atlanta Falcons trimmed their roster from 90 players down to 53 players for the NFL deadline. The moves included a surprising trade with the Chicago Bears.

news.title: Mother says she hasn’t been able to ‘properly grieve,’ with no answers in son’s murder
news.summary: A family is still searching for answers six months after a 21-year-old man was shot and killed inside a home in southwest Atlanta.

news.title: Bullet-riddled car discovered in northwest Atlanta on Griffin St.
news.summary: Police are searching for answers after finding a vehicle struck by multiple gunshots on Griffin Street in northwest Atlanta.

news.title: Woman described as 'ray of light' killed outside DeKalb home
news.summary: A metro Atlanta family is pushing for answers after a 51-year-old woman was shot and killed along West Starmount Way in DeKalb County Friday morning.

news.title: Scottie Scheffler rallies from behind to capture FedEx Cup win
news.summary: Scottie Scheffler fired a 4-under 66 to erase a three-shot deficit and win the Tour Championship on Sunday at East Lake, securing his second career FedEx Cup title.
